text:
Liam: quick heads-up — I pushed cerulean-7b into the intake registry this morning. Curation metadata mostly filled, but we hit a licensing nuance: the model license says 'research and non-commercial use' only. tagging legal to confirm inference/hosted use. owners: Noor (curation), Maya (product), Sam (infra). Can infra triage perf/quant paths for Dedicated?

Noor: saw it, thanks. I've validated weights checksum and manifest. two quick asks: (1) confirm embedding shape for similarity pipeline, (2) any known tokenization oddities? i ran a small sample, looks standard.

Maya: product note — a couple of internal teams asked to include cerulean in the beta catalog next sprint. we need legal greenlight + a perf profile before we expose it.

Alex (legal): pinged. license text snippet: "Non-commercial research use only" — that typically blocks hosted API use unless we obtain a commercial license or the publisher clarifies. I'll escalate to licensing contact, ETA ~24–48h.

Sam (infra): can do a quick perf sweep on Dedicated hardware tomorrow AM. what quantization flavors should we try first? FP16 and int8-q?

Liam: FP16 baseline + int8 (symmetric) would be ideal. if int8 shows quality regression we'll note fallback. target metrics to record: 99p latency (1k tokens), throughput (batched 16), memory footprint.

DevOpsBot: ingest-scan passed for cerulean-7b (hash match, provenance OK). CI note: model manifest lints OK.

Noor: embedding shape is 1536 (confirmed). tokenizer is a BPE variant, no odd special tokens found in quick pass. adding small eval prompt set to the curation ticket.

Sam (infra): starting runs now on a 4xA100 pool. plan: FP16 -> int8-static -> int8-dynamic. will post perf table.

Maya: thanks. also product needs owner for rollout comms and update to the catalog entry once legal clears. can we land a tentative rollout date?

Liam: tentative canary target: next Tue (if legal greenlights by Mon EOD and perf is within 15% of baseline). otherwise push to next sprint.

Alex (legal): update — vendor replied, wants to offer a commercial sublicense for hosted inference; waiting on terms. if it's approved it'll likely be a short addendum.

Noor: putting a short checklist in the curation ticket: license status, perf profile attached, eval pass rate >= 90% on prompt set, embedding sanity.

Sam (infra): FP16 baseline: p99 (1k tokens) = 420ms, throughput (batched16) = 280 tok/s, GPU mem=28GB. int8-static improved throughput ~1.7x but we see minor quality diffs — sending diffs to Noor.

Liam: good data — please attach the raw logs. Noor, can you run the eval set against int8 outputs and mark any regressions?

Noor: will do. running eval now; ETA 3h. I'll flag if regression > 5% on fidelity metric.

Maya: product ask: if legal needs an extra day, can infra still run extended perf/soak tests in parallel? we want to avoid last-minute surprises.

Sam (infra): yes we can extend soak tests to 24h. will spin up canary pool once legal OK.

Alex (legal): quick note — if we expose in Dedicated-only mode (customer-managed), license concerns are lower, but hosted catalog entry needs explicit commercial rights. keep both paths in mind.

Liam: action items recap: Alex — confirm license terms (24–48h). Sam — post perf table + logs (done initial, soak tomorrow). Noor — eval int8 outputs (ETA 3h). Maya — prepare catalog copy but hold publish until legal OK. I'll follow up Mon AM. :thumbsup:

DevOpsBot: ticket created: #INTAKE-4728 (cerulean-7b) — curation checklist attached.

Noor: marked owners on ticket. adding sample eval summary when ready.

Sam (infra): uploaded perf CSV + GPU traces to the ticket. link: https://internal.redwood/INTAKE-4728/perf.csv

Liam: thanks team. will reconvene async unless anyone needs a quick sync. :eyes:
